title: Saray
type: Survivor of grief; Wrath’s final opponent
imageAlt: Portrait of Saray, survivor of grief and opponent of Wrath
imageCaption: Saray — survivor of grief and Wrath’s final opponent.
dek: An archer whose work in Gael joins anger, grief, love and the continued defense of her companions; she lands the final blow against Wrath.
body:
After Nienna dies in their fight with soul eaters and wraiths on the Plains of Trial, Saray defeats the remaining enemies and brings her body to the Tower. She blames herself for the loss. Dale remains beside her without pretending that love gives him the power to decide when guilt is over.

Her care also takes a practical form. She petitions Nuru’s messenger and offers husks and gold for a diamond, then gives it to Elenia. Elenia’s Raise Dead restores Nienna on 15 July 2024. The recovery does not by itself establish how Saray’s guilt changes afterward.

Anger and the purpose of fighting

In an early investigation, Saray rejects Dale’s suggestion that their purpose might be revenge: she says they want to stop someone from hurting others. Later, facing Wrath after Dale’s first death, she refuses his claim that the whole world deserves blame. She blames him and Death’s servants for the suffering they cause.

That answer does not make her immune to fear or rage. Once Wrath withdraws, she lowers her bow and breaks into tears, feeling powerless. Her later victories belong to the history of someone who has felt that helplessness; they do not prove she was fearless from the beginning.

A promise for the one who lives

After Dale’s July return, Saray brings him food and stays with him while he worries about pain and his changed music. She asks him to promise that if she dies, he will move on. Dale agrees on the condition that she promise the same, and they seal it together.

She is doing more than reassuring someone who fears losing her. She states what she wants for the survivor, while accepting that his wishes matter too. The promise does not remove their fear or prescribe how anyone else must grieve.

The final blow and the people still to save

During the November battle, Saray watches Dale fall and struggles to say goodbye. Still crying, she calls on the company to keep fighting. When further danger makes the bodies unreachable, she urges the survivors to continue. Elenia’s restoration of Dale brings a moment of disbelief and relief within that same encounter.

Days later in the source record, Saray lands the final blow against Wrath. The checked sequence connects her earlier helplessness with continued action and a decisive shot. It does not turn the victory into proof that she has finished grieving or supply a single motive for everything she does.

Akarian’s lesson with Dale

In the training account posted on 12 October 2024 (UTC), Saray urges Dale to keep his distance from their enemies. When magical control turns him against her, she attacks the source and calls for him to return to himself. Even as the fight worsens, she tells him that he is a decisive part of the war and that they need him. The pair lose the exercise; Akarian heals them and draws a lesson from the weaknesses the opponents exploited. Their defeat does not establish a death, a completed field mission, or a rupture between them.

Imagining a life in the restored land

After the immediate war, Saray can also imagine a future that includes building and music. She gives Dale a gift and says that if he builds in Gael, they will at least hear his wonderful music. Their affection includes ordinary plans for living there, alongside the danger they have survived together.

The exchange records encouragement and a plan. It does not certify that the house is finished or make every later choice an uncomplicated recovery from the past.

June · staying with the company

Saray joins Arjahn, Scribonia and Gartina on a supply journey from the Refuge, keeping watch as she moves through the greenery. The green dragon frightens her badly. Arjahn reminds her of what their wider company has faced; she is not wholly reassured, but she decides not to abandon the others.

After the dragon falls she gathers materials while ashamed of her performance. The shame is her own assessment, not a narrator’s judgment that she contributed nothing. Her fear in this later encounter stands alongside her established Gael victories, including the final blow against Wrath.

Scenes in sequence

These selected scenes preserve what was knowable when people acted. Dates below identify source postings in UTC; they do not supply an in-world calendar. A later appearance does not settle present status.

  1. 2024-07-08 · quest

    Facing Wrath without feeling powerful

    Saray rejects Wrath’s blame of the world, then breaks down after he withdraws.

    Known at this stage
    Dale has died and Wrath is offering restoration through Death.
    Consequence
    Her anger and helplessness precede both Nienna’s loss and her eventual final shot.
    Still unresolved
    This scene does not establish that every later action has one motive.

    Receipt 1 · Receipt 2

  2. 2024-07-09 → 2024-07-15 · compatible RP

    Bringing the means for Nienna’s return

    Saray survives the Plains fight and brings Nienna’s body home, then obtains a diamond through an altar offering. Elenia uses it to cast Raise Dead and restore Nienna.

    Known at this stage
    The death and recovery of the body precede the diamond offering and successful casting.
    Consequence
    Saray’s survival, recovery work and offering belong beside Elenia’s spell in Nienna’s return.
    Still unresolved
    Saray’s guilt remains her self-assessment; the recovery does not establish that the guilt has ended.

    Receipt 1 · Receipt 2 · Receipt 3 · Receipt 4 · Receipt 5 · Receipt 6 · Receipt 7 · Receipt 8 · Receipt 9 · Receipt 10 · Receipt 11

  3. 2024-07-10 · compatible RP

    A mutual promise for the survivor

    Saray asks Dale to keep living if she dies. He asks the same of her, and she agrees to their mutual promise.

    Known at this stage
    Dale has returned and both know that another expedition may kill them.
    Consequence
    Each recognizes that attachment should leave the other a future.
    Still unresolved
    The promise records their wishes; it does not establish that future grief will be simple or impose the same choice on anyone else.

    Receipt 1 · Receipt 2 · Receipt 3

  4. 2024-10-12 · quest

    A commitment inside the trial

    Saray accepts Dale’s proposal; Akarian directs that the rings go to Elenia.

    Known at this stage
    The characters are making commitments under the pressure of the test.
    Consequence
    The scene preserves relationship and devotion beside combat readiness.
    Still unresolved
    A decision about the rings is not a universal inheritance or ownership rule.

    Receipt 1 · Receipt 2

  5. 2024-11-17 · quest

    Continuing while grieving

    Saray calls on the company to keep fighting after Dale falls and later urges retreat; his return astonishes her.

    Known at this stage
    The survivors cannot recover every fallen companion safely.
    Consequence
    Her contribution includes decisions under grief before the later defeat of Wrath.
    Still unresolved
    Continuing to act is not proof of completed emotional recovery.

    Receipt 1 · Receipt 2 · Receipt 3 · Receipt 4

  6. 2024-11-21 · quest

    The final blow against Wrath

    Saray makes her last shot; the narration describes Wrath collapsing, and Scribonia observes her final blow.

    Known at this stage
    The company has suffered grievous losses and still faces immediate danger.
    Consequence
    The checked sequence preserves Saray’s decisive role without replacing the party’s contributions.
    Still unresolved
    Victory does not explain the later return of every fallen companion.

    Receipt 1 · Receipt 2 · Receipt 3

  7. 2025-03-04 · quest

    Supporting Dale’s plans to build

    Saray gives Dale a gift and imagines hearing his music in Gael if he builds there.

    Known at this stage
    The couple are discussing a possible future home.
    Consequence
    Her history includes supporting ordinary life after battle.
    Still unresolved
    The house’s completion and gift’s properties are not established.

    Receipt 1 · Receipt 2 · Receipt 3

  8. 2026-06-23–24 · quest

    Courage includes the wish to run

    Saray fears the green dragon, stays rather than abandon her companions and gathers materials after it falls.

    Known at this stage
    The scale of the encounter feels overwhelming to her.
    Consequence
    She remains part of the expedition despite fear and self-criticism.
    Still unresolved
    Her judgment of her performance does not diminish her quest-established achievements.

    Receipt 1 · Receipt 2 · Receipt 3 · Receipt 4

profile.personality: Saray is a decisive field adventurer whose presence becomes clearest at moments when hesitation would cost the party its opening. She contributes observation, ranged precision, and the willingness to continue through ruins, ships, storms, and tombs.
profile.achievements: Her arrow kills the giant abomination guarding the meteor orb, and she later helps investigate the reality-splitting ritual, recover Jiangshi at Gael, break Eovar’s blockade, and escape the Gael tomb. These deeds place her in several of the early campaign’s most dangerous turning points.
profile.relationships: Dale, Elenia, Quake, Gartina, Wren, Scribonia, and Adelia recur across Saray’s expeditions. Her record is that of a trusted teammate within a dense company rather than a solitary legend, with relationships made visible by coordinated action under pressure.
